kitEvidence.formula:
Dr. Mundo pumps himself with chemicals, gaining [(0.15 / 0.2 / 0.25) × 100]% of his missing Health as max Health, [(0.15 / 0.25 / 0.35) × 100]% Move Speed, and regenerating [(0.2 / 0.4 / 0.6) × 100]% max Health over [10] seconds.

At Rank 3, both healing effects are increased by an additional [5]% per nearby enemy champion.

builds.name: Blunt Force Trauma: HP becomes AD
builds.summary: Explore a large Blunt Force Trauma empowered attack number under fixed conditions, comparing legal item swaps rather than assuming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Explore a large Blunt Force Trauma empowered attack number under fixed conditions, comparing legal item swaps rather than assuming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Rank-5 E passively grants 3.2% maximum HP as AD, then its attack adds 45 + 5% bonus HP before the documented missing-health increase to the bonus. Bloodmail converts bonus HP to AD again through its own independent passive; Warmog adds finite item HP and Sterak uses observed base AD. Titanic is an HP/AD slot and a separate on-hit packet, not an additional multiplier on E.

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: Dr Mundo gains [((2 / 2.3 / 2.6 / 2.9 / 3.2) × Stat(12)) × (0.01)] Attack Damage.

Active: Dr Mundo violently swings his "medical" bag, causing his next Attack to deal an additional [5 / 15 / 25 / 35 / 45 + (0.05) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] physical damage, increased by up to [1.4 + -1] based on his missing Health. If the enemy is killed, Mundo swats them away, dealing [5 / 15 / 25 / 35 / 45 + (0.05) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] physical damage to enemies they pass through.
